purpose: Finish the matching 10-page THC Simple User Guide visual set without changing the locked beginner copy.

designSystem.composition: one clear central educational illustration plus short information blocks

items.teachingPurpose: Show that the grow space must be ready before starting seeds.
items.artDirection: Simple grow setup with light or sun, draining pot, grow mix, water, airflow, and drying/curing-space reminder.
items.requiredAction: Independent scientific, visual, accessibility, and page-placement review; file already meets print-master dimensions.

items.artDirection: Simple seed opening with a small white root; emphasize moisture, warmth, gentle handling, and patience.
items.requiredAction: Rebuild at 2550x3300 using the locked copy and recovered composition as reference.

items.artDirection: Small healthy seedling in a pot with gentle, uncluttered visual cues.
items.requiredAction: Rebuild from the low-resolution composition reference at 2550x3300; do not upscale the 311x533 reference and call it a master.

items.teachingPurpose: Teach that veg is the plant-building stage.
items.artDirection: Healthy young plant getting bigger with simple emphasis on roots, stems, leaves, and branches.
items.requiredAction: Rebuild at 2550x3300 using the locked copy and recovered composition as reference.

items.teachingPurpose: Teach that flower is the bud-forming stage and patience matters.
items.artDirection: Cannabis plant beginning to form buds; keep airflow and moisture-risk cues subtle and beginner-friendly.
items.requiredAction: Create new master at 2550x3300 from the locked Flower prompt. Do not use the detailed legacy Flower candidate as the final beginner page.

items.teachingPurpose: Teach not to harvest too early.
items.artDirection: Clean scissors near a mature branch with full buds; avoid adding numeric maturity claims.
items.requiredAction: Strengthen claim-level evidence for maturity cues, then rebuild at 2550x3300 and run independent review.

items.teachingPurpose: Teach drying as a critical step, not an afterthought.
items.artDirection: Harvested branches hanging in a clean, dark drying space with gentle indirect airflow.
items.requiredAction: Create new 2550x3300 master from the locked non-numeric Dry prompt.

items.teachingPurpose: Teach cure as the final finishing and storage step.
items.artDirection: Clean containers holding dried flower in cool, dark storage with a mold-check cue.
items.requiredAction: Create new 2550x3300 master from the locked Cure prompt; do not add universal time or humidity targets.

items.teachingPurpose: Teach early pest spotting without turning the page into pest science.
items.artDirection: Calm inspection of the underside of leaves with a magnifier and small generic warning icons.
items.requiredAction: Create new 2550x3300 master from the locked Pests prompt; keep treatment instructions out of the page.

items.teachingPurpose: Give the new grower simple survival rules.
items.artDirection: Clean closing checklist with simple icons and strong spacing consistency with pages 1-9.
items.requiredAction: Create new 2550x3300 master from the locked Tips prompt.
